text:
Lena (Sales): Passing Heliox Labs to CS 120-seat pilot, EU-only, wants private deploy (VPC) + HSM/KMS for keys, SAML SSO, and token-level billing exports to their internal billing. They plan a pilot start 2025-07-07 and want audit logs for every API call. They also plan a 1-off large embedding job (batch) ~10M vectors during pilot. No prod data yet; they'll use synthetic PII during eval. Please own onboarding and highlight infra or compliance blockers.

Ravi (CS): Thanks Lena. Quick Qs: who is their IT contact? and what's expected concurrency for the embedding job (qps, batch windows)? Need to flag data residency and audit log retention policy.

Lena (Sales): IT contact is Marco (Heliox infra). Embedding job will run as a nightly bulk job over 48h, estimated 5-10k qps peak for ingestion, but steady-state user-facing calls expected <50 concurrent. They asked for p95 token latency <200ms for gen endpoints.

Ravi (CS): Got it. Top risks: EU-only private deploy lead time, HSM/KMS integration + key import, and embedding throughput requiring special batching config. Tentative owners: Ravi (onboarding), Sam (support lead), Priya (security eng), Lena (sales sponsor). I'll open the support ticket and schedule kickoff.

Sam (Support): I'll create a ticket and a runbook stub with these checks: - VPC peering & IP allowlist - KMS key wrapping import steps - Audit log retention/rotation - Bulk embedding ingress throttling & shard sizing - SSO SAML metadata exchange. Also note dedicated GPUs for large-ish models need provisioning.

deploy-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-7420 "Heliox private deploy + HSM + bulk embeddings" assigned to Sam.

Priya (Security Eng): A couple of items: 1) KMS/HSM import may require external compliance sign-off depending on key origin. 2) We need expected max sequence length and model family to validate side-channel surface area for the private runtime. 3) Audit log schema: do they want raw request bodies logged? that'll affect PII handling.

Ravi (CS): Action items I'm logging: 1) Kickoff invite + enablement (owner: Ravi) 2) Open support ticket + runbook (owner: Sam -> SUP-7420) 3) Confirm model choices & max seq with customer (owner: Lena -> Marco) 4) Billing export spec & sample format (owner: Ravi + Billing Ops) 5) Draft KMS/HSM onboarding checklist (owner: Priya) 6) Capacity & batching plan for embeddings (owner: Sam + Eng) 7) Add renewal flag and timeline (owner: Ravi)

Lena (Sales): I'll ask Marco to confirm the model family and whether they plan to run embeddings on a retrieval index engine (approx vector size). I'll also capture their preferred legal billing cadence; they were interested in a 12-month commit.

Sam (Support): Runbook quick snippet in SUP-7420: ```- Validate SAML metadata exchange and SP endpoints
- Confirm VPC peering CIDR and routing tables
- KMS: import vs. use-provider managed (record method)
- Configure ingestion throttles + worker shard count for 10M vectors
- Audit logs: define retention (90/365/forever) and scrub rules``` Tagging @Priya for KMS steps.

Priya (Security Eng): I'll draft a one-page KMS/HSM checklist for Marco's team (key algs, wrapping, rotation windows, attestations). Also will propose audit log retention policy defaults (90 days rolling) and redaction rules for PII unless they request longer with justification.

Ravi (CS): Scheduled kickoff: 2025-06-30 09:00 UTC (invite sent to Heliox + Sam + Priya + Lena). Link to enablement slides: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/heliox (please skim before kickoff).

Sam (Support): I'll follow up in SUP-7420 with initial capacity estimate. For model sizing: if they use a ~13B dense model for embeddings we can provision 2xA40 equiv for embedding throughput; for 70B gen use-case we should plan 6xA100-80GB equiv. Need final model to lock.

Lena (Sales): Also noting renewal indicator: they asked about tiered pricing and a clause for overage credits in year 2. Ravi please add renewal watch and set touchpoints at 180/120/60 days.

Ravi (CS): Will add renewal watch in SFDC and set reminders. I'll also capture pilot feedback loop: post-pilot NPS + perf survey to be sent to Marco & product team (CC @Priya for security notes).

Sam (Support): After kickoff I'll convert runbook notes into a persistent internal doc and include a testing checklist for the bulk embedding job (ingest sub-batch test + verify KV/prefix cache behavior).

Lena (Sales): Thanks everyone. One last note from Marco: they'd like an onboarding checklist they can share with their infra team. Ravi, can you prepare a 1-page checklist and post here before EOD?

Ravi (CS): Yep. I'll post the 1-page infra + SSO + KMS checklist here by EOD. Closing handoff thread 0d, keep updates in SUP-7420 and the kickoff calendar.
